title: Momentum Multi-Marginal Schrödinger Bridge Matching
tldr_zh: 相空间提升+多点条件化随机桥，学习满足多个位置约束的测度值样条；matching 迭代中保持中间边缘不变，解决两两插值丢失长程时序依赖的问题
tldr_en: Phase-space lifting with multi-point conditional bridges learns smooth measure-valued splines satisfying multiple positional constraints; matching preserves intermediate marginals throughout training
